1) $(3m+6m):9$，当$m=-12,-5.96$时；
2) $(5.2a-5.2b):5.2$，当$a=-27,b=-3.64$时.

view.stem:
求证：当变数为任何值时，下列等式都成立：
1) $-28k:(-7)=4k$；
2) $64x:(-8)=-8x$.

变量为实数。选择所有成立的完整证明或定义域判断。

options.text: 第一式只有在k≠0时成立，因为证明必须先除以k。

intent.source_solution:
For any realk, (-7)*(4k)=-28k; since-7!=0 the definition of division gives(-28k)/(-7)=4k. Equivalently coefficient division gives((-28)/(-7))*k=4k. Fork=0 both sides0, no exceptional point.

For any realx, (-8)*(-8x)=64x; since-8!=0 the definition gives(64x)/(-8)=-8x. Equivalently(64/(-8))*x=-8x. Forx=0 both sides0. These proofs divide constant coefficients, not k or x; no nonzero-variable restriction.
